core_obligations: (item-power, item-generators, item-dimension, item-standardizer) Choose N with q^N inside H_{A/k} Lambda_q, generators a_j of H_{A/R}, set d = dim Lambda_q and B = A[x_1, ..., x_d, z_{ij}]/(x_i^{2N} - sum z_{ij} a_j).

(item-elkik, item-strictly-standard) Apply the improve-presentation lemma to get B -> C with a section; each B_{x_i} is smooth over k[x] with free differentials, so some power x_i^c is strictly standard in C by the compare-standard lemma.
(item-set-n, item-set-E, item-NP) Set n = N + dc and e = 8c; the solution-modulo lemma gives the factorization k[y]_p/p^n -> D -> Lambda_q/q^n Lambda_q containing the images of the generators of A.

(item-choose-pii, item-modify-pii) Pick parameters pi_i of k[y]_p of dimension d, set R = k[y, t] and gamma_i = pi_i t_i; a regular-sequence induction using Ogoma's lemma enforces the displayed annihilator equalities Ann(gamma_i) = Ann(gamma_i^2).

(item-choose-deltai) An induction of length d enlarges D to D' and produces delta_i not in q with pi_i' = delta_i pi_i satisfying (a) pi_i'^{2N} = sum a_j lambda_{ij}, (b) the annihilator equalities in Lambda, (c) delta_i in D'; the key observation pi^N c'_j mapping to zero in bar-Lambda plus Ogoma and the enlarge-solution-modulo lemma carry the step; the choice of the multiplier s is the cleared-denominators mechanical step the source marks 'minor detail omitted'.

(item-map-B-Lambda, item-set-map-R) Define B -> Lambda by x_i -> pi_i', z_{ij} -> lambda_{ij}, the retraction C -> B composes to C -> Lambda, and map R -> Lambda by phi on k[y] and t_i -> delta_i with k[x] -> R sending x_i to gamma_i.

(item-first-solve) It suffices to resolve R -> C tensor R -> Lambda superset q, because the radical of H over Lambda contains h_A and any solution there solves the original situation as R is smooth over k.
(item-second-resolve) By the lift-solution lemma with the strictly standard sequence gamma_i^c, it suffices to resolve modulo I = (gamma_1^e, ..., gamma_d^e).
(item-third-resolve) By the delocalize-height-zero lemma it suffices to resolve after localizing at the prime r over q.

(item-fourth-resolve, item-fifth-resolve, item-sixth-resolve) Successive reductions: quotient by J = (pi_1^e, ..., pi_d^e) in k[y], then replace the target by Lambda_q/q^n Lambda_q using n = N + dc large enough that p^n sits inside J_p and q^n inside J Lambda_q.

(item-seventh-resolve, item-eighth-resolve, item-done) Replace C by B using the section, and factor through D'[t_1, ..., t_d], a filtered colimit of smooth R_p/p^nR_p-algebras in which the displayed B quotient lands; the final twist maps x_i to the image of pi_i t_i and z_{ij} to the image of lambda_{ij} t_i^{2N}/delta_i^{2N} so that the two diagrams commute.
proof_roadmap: Twelve-step reduction chain: construction of B; standardization and strict standardness; Artinian factorization; parameter and annihilator control; delta enlargement; reduction to R, to the quotient by I, to the localization, to the quotient by J, modulo p^n; section replacement; final smooth colimit factorization.
